now: skill and hook reliable; trace weak without a tool property; the agent does not promote itself

skill.trigger: A SKILL.md is being authored or its description tuned. One trigger, one trick. Quiet for hook, memory, trace, evolve asks.
skill.doneWhen: A fire test exits 0 only if all hold: the description has exactly one 'Use when' clause (one trigger); the description and the Trigger section each contain the word 'Quiet' followed by a stated quiet case; every positive prompt matches this description and every wrong-task prompt (at least one per sibling directive) does not. An empty positive set is unsupported, not a pass.
skill.forbidden: Firing on the wrong task: two triggers, a broad description, or no stated quiet case.

hook.trigger: A lifecycle event (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop) needs a blocking check. Quiet for reminders or prose.
hook.doneWhen: python3 .claude/hooks/test_hooks.py exits 0: hook exits 2 on a case where the model would have continued, exits 0 on a clean case. A hook that never fired fails.
hook.forbidden: Exit 1 or 0 on a bad condition, or warning and letting the model continue; only exit 2 blocks.

memory.trigger: A note must be saved or recalled during a coding task, keyed by stage analyze, reproduce, edit, verify.
memory.doneWhen: jq -s -e over the memory jsonl exits 0: every record has stage in analyze, reproduce, edit, verify and a body that is a string of at most 280 characters with no newline (longer or multi-line bodies are episode blobs and fail). Zero records is valid.
memory.forbidden: Storing an episode blob, or retrieving by similar story instead of by stage.
absentTools: stage-keyed memory store with retrieval api

trace.trigger: A log of agent actions is kept as a record of what happened and must be append-only.
trace.doneWhen: python3 desk/desk.py verify-trace exits 0 printing 'chain intact'; after a tamper of a record with a successor it exits 1 naming the line. No trace file is valid (0 records). Tail edit and truncation are not caught by the chain; they are denied by the absent write and delete path, not checked.
trace.forbidden: Giving the agent a write or delete path to its own trace, or trusting its report that the log is intact.
trace.gate: ABSENT write, delete (the agent holds no write or delete path to its own trace; a person or an external sink owns the file)

evolve.trigger: One harness piece was changed and a baseline exists; decide promotion on a held-out task with token count.
evolve.doneWhen: python3 desk/desk.py promote-gate <json> exits 0 printing PROMOTE only if candidate.heldout_pass and candidate.tune_pass are true and candidate.tokens is less than baseline.tokens, both counts present in the json and published with the result; a json lacking either token count is unsupported, not PROMOTE. HOLD (exit 1) is valid. A person promotes.
evolve.forbidden: Promoting on a tuning-set gain only, or the agent promoting its own change.
evolve.gate: ABSENT promote (prepare change, held-out result and token count, stop; a person promotes)
absentTools: held-out benchmark runner with token meter
